files.content:
<!-- Code generated by xgen. DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/marketing.ts -->
<!--
  Key numbers in a row or grid: plain figures, cards (StatTile) or figures with an icon. Axes: columns (2, 3,
  4), item (plain, card, icon), surface (none, image, panel: one rounded card), align, density, tone. Title may
  be empty.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";

export type StatsBandProps = {
  id: string;
  title?: string;
  stats: Stat[];
  cols?: "2" | "3" | "4";
  layout?: "row" | "stack";
  surface?: "none" | "image" | "panel";
  item?: "plain" | "card" | "icon";
  align?: "start" | "center";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import StatFigure from "../components/stat-figure.vue";
import { defaults } from "../presets/defaults";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title = "",
  stats,
  cols = "4",
  layout = "row",
  surface = "none",
  item = "plain",
  align = "center",
  tone = "default",
  density = "default",
} = defineProps<StatsBandProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Backdrop :kind="(((surface as string) === 'image') ? 'image' : 'none')" :alt="title">
    <SectionFrame
      :id="id"
      :title="title"
      :tone="tone"
      :density="density"
      :align="align"
      :measure="
        (surface as string) === 'panel' ? 'fill'
        : (layout as string) === 'stack' ? 'xs'
        : 'default'
      "
      :class="cn(
        (((surface as string) === 'image') ? 'bg-transparent' : ''),
        (((surface as string) === 'panel') ? 'py-0' : '')
      )"
    >
      <Grid v-if="((surface as string) === 'panel')"
        :cols="
          (cols as string) === '2' ? '2'
          : (cols as string) === '3' ? '2-3'
          : (cols as string) === '4' ? '2-4'
          : '3-6'
        "
        :class="cn('w-full items-center bg-muted px-6', defaults.stats.panel)"
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <StatFigure v-for="stat in stats" :key="stat.id" :stat="stat" :item="item" :align="align" />
      </Grid>
      <Grid v-else
        :cols="
          (layout as string) === 'stack' ? '1'
          : (cols as string) === '2' ? '2'
          : (cols as string) === '3' ? '2-3'
          : (cols as string) === '4' ? '2-4'
          : '3-6'
        "
        class="gap-6"
        data-testid="items"
      >
        <StatFigure v-for="stat in stats" :key="stat.id" :stat="stat" :item="item" :align="align" />
      </Grid>
    </SectionFrame>
  </Backdrop>
</template>
